resources.string: Use the phone as a TV remote: by infrared on phones that have an emitter, or over Wi-Fi for Android TV, Google TV, Samsung, LG and Roku
Control a TV by infrared or over Wi-Fi
The infrared codes the TV remote sends for each brand
The registration an LG TV is shown when the TV remote pairs with it
The buttons you pressed, sent to a TV or player on your own network, and the searches that find them there. Nothing goes to the internet.

The remotes the panel shows as chips, the last one used first. Tap one to rename it, change its codes, pair it again or remove it. Pairing keys stay on this phone and are not part of a settings backup.
No remotes yet. Add one below.
Infrared works on phones with an infrared emitter, pointed at the TV, with no setup on the TV. Network remotes need the TV and this phone on the same Wi-Fi, and are paired once.
Pick your TV\'s brand, then the code set it answers
A Flipper Zero .ir file, for a TV, projector, air conditioner or anything else with a remote
That file has no buttons this phone can send.
Android TV, Google TV, Samsung, LG and Roku
For a TV the search doesn\'t find
The TV\'s address on your network, such as 192.168.1.20. It\'s in the TV\'s network settings.
This phone has no infrared emitter, and this build can\'t reach your network, so there is no remote to add.
Brands use more than one set of codes. Point the phone at the TV and try Power on each set until the TV answers, then use that one.
Nothing answered. Check that the TV is on and on the same Wi-Fi as this phone, or add it by its address.
Look at the TV: it asks whether to allow WM Keyboard. Choose Allow with the TV\'s own remote.
Look at the TV: it asks whether to accept WM Keyboard. Choose Accept with the TV\'s own remote.
The TV now shows a code of six letters and numbers. Type it here.
That isn\'t the code on the TV. Check it and try again.
Paired. The remote is in the keyboard\'s Remote panel.
The TV said no. Try again and accept on the TV.
Nobody answered on the TV in time. Try again and accept the prompt.
Nothing answered at that address. Check that the TV is on and on the same Wi-Fi as this phone.
Nothing answered at that address. Check that the TV is on and on the same Wi-Fi, and that the Android TV Remote Service or Google TV app is up to date on the TV.
The Roku is refusing remotes. On the Roku, open Settings, System, Advanced system settings, Control by mobile apps, and allow network access.
Remove it? Its codes or pairing are deleted from this phone.
Pick a button, then paste its code as Pronto hex (it starts with 0000) or as raw timings. A pasted code replaces the brand set\'s for that button; leave the box empty to go back to it.
